searchText: I don't quite follow why you say "would not be able to justify again until all Prysm validators were ejected". Why ejected, why not effective total balance <33%? that's correct, the right thing would be until they are less than 33% It just so happens that apparently prysm is the only client alive now on Goerli so we may as well just remove the validator db and hope the slasher is not up Thanks, just checking that I understand the possibly consequences for mainnet. And indeed makes sense to just do whatever works for Goerli, as it's deprecated anyway
